title: Indices of compatible terms
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a finite list of conjunctions of literals on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate a status of free, fixed to $+1$, or fixed to $-1$. The compatible term indices are the indices in the formula's list whose corresponding term is compatible with $\rho$.
